---
title: "CEBR 3D Map (template)"
author: "ROSSyndicate"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

Builds the CEBR Blowhard Spring 3D figure with `render_map_3d()`
(`src/map_3d.R`). To make one for another park, copy this file and change
the AOI, the layers, and the view.

Rendering uses {rayshader}. On macOS, {rgl} and {rayrender} need XQuartz
(<https://www.xquartz.org>) to load, even when no window is opened.

```{r setup}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

# Render off-screen (set before rayshader loads)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
source("setup.R")
library(rayshader)

```

# 1. AOI and layers

Any sf objects in any CRS. Each layer gets a legend name, a style, and
optionally a callout box (position as a fraction of the image from the top
left).

```{r layers}

park_dir <- "data/park/CEBR/report_data"

park_boundary <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "park_boundary.rds"))

recharge_area <- readRDS("data/park/CEBR/Climate_Data/recharge_area.rds")

blowhard_intake <- read_excel("data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx",
                              sheet = 1, na = c("NA", "U"), skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(park_unit == "CEBR", !source_type %in% c("hauled", "Hauled")) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("source_longitude", "source_latitude"), crs = 4326)

streams <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "park_flowlines.rds"))
springs <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "springs_joined.rds"))
faults <- st_read("data/park/CEBR/cebr_geology_gdb/cebr_geology.gdb", layer = "cebrflt", quiet = TRUE)

visitor_center <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "buildings.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(BLDGNAME == "Visitor Center")

# OpenStreetMap main roads (cached by 3D_Map.Rmd)
roads <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "osm_roads.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(highway %in% c("primary", "secondary"))

test_well <- st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = -112.846386, lat = 37.607578),
                      coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
weather_station <- readRDS(file.path(park_dir, "blowhard_station.rds"))

# Drawn in this order (later layers on top)
layers <- list(
  map3d_layer(park_boundary, "Cedar Breaks Boundary", "line", color = "#1b7a4a", width = 6,
              callout = map3d_callout("Cedar Breaks", 0.25, 0.20)),
  map3d_layer(streams, "Streams", "line", color = "#9fd3ff", width = 2, legend = FALSE),
  map3d_layer(roads, "Roads", "line", color = "gray72", width = 2.5),
  map3d_layer(recharge_area, "Blowhard Recharge Area", "fill", color = "hotpink", width = 2),
  map3d_layer(faults, "Faults", "line", color = "#252525", width = 4),
  map3d_layer(springs, "Springs", "point", color = "hotpink", size_m = 75),
  map3d_layer(blowhard_intake, "Blowhard Intake", "point", color = "hotpink", size_m = 75,
              legend = FALSE, callout = map3d_callout("Blowhard Intake", 0.80, 0.20)),
  map3d_layer(visitor_center, "Visitor Center", "point", color = "#ffd400", size_m = 200,
              outline = "gray15", callout = map3d_callout("Visitor Center", 0.55, 0.10)),
  map3d_layer(test_well, "Test Well", "point", color = "#1f78b4", size_m = 150,
              callout = map3d_callout("Test Well", 0.70, 0.08)),
  map3d_layer(weather_station, "Weather Station", "square", color = "#252525", size_m = 150,
              callout = map3d_callout("Blowhard Mtn. Radar\nWeather Station", 0.88, 0.29))
)

```

# 2. Views

`from` is the side the camera sits on ("NW" = looking southeast), or set
`theta` directly. Overlay positions can be overridden per view.

```{r views}

views <- list(
  basin = map3d_view(theta = -145, phi = 50, zoom = 0.85, fov = 20,
                     north_arrow = c(0.10, 0.70),
                     scalebar = list(km = 5, edge = "N", start = 0.10, inset = 0.01,
                                     shift = c(-0.10, 0.05)))
  # mountain = map3d_view(from = "S", phi = 25, zoom = 0.65, fov = 40)
)

```

# 3. Render

`preview = TRUE` shows a quick render in the plot pane and saves nothing.
For the report figure, set `preview = FALSE` and give `out_dir`.

```{r render}

render_map_3d(
  aoi = park_boundary, layers = layers, views = views,
  dem = "data/park/CEBR/report_data/park_dem.tif", buffer_m = 5000, dem_agg = 6,
  z_exag = 2, drape = "hillshade",
  legend_order = c("Blowhard Recharge Area", "Cedar Breaks Boundary", "Faults", "Springs",
                   "Visitor Center", "Test Well", "Weather Station", "Roads"),
  notes = paste("Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (via elevatr).",
                "Roads: OpenStreetMap contributors. Shaded relief from the elevation model."),
  preview = TRUE
  # preview = FALSE, out_dir = "data/park/CEBR/Figs", prefix = "catchment_3d_template"
)

```
